title: PhyMotion: Structured 3D Motion Reward for Physics-Grounded Human Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.14269v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generating realistic human motion is a central yet unsolved challenge in video generation. While reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training has driven recent gains in general video quality, extending it to human motion remains bottlenecked by a reward signal that cannot reliably score motion realism. Existing video rewards primarily rely on 2D perceptual signals, without explicitly modeling the 3D body state, contact, and dynamics underlying articulated human motion, and often assign high scores to videos with floating bodies or physically implausible movements. To address this, we propose PhyMotion, a structured, fine-grained motion reward that grounds recovered 3D human trajectories in a physics simulator and evaluates motion quality along multiple dimensions of physical feasibility. translated_title: PhyMotion：面向物理合理人体视频生成的结构化三维运动奖励
translated_abstract: 生成逼真的人体运动是视频生成领域一个核心但尚未解决的挑战。尽管基于强化学习（RL）的后训练近年来显著提升了整体视频质量，但将其扩展到人体运动仍然受制于一个瓶颈：现有奖励信号无法可靠地评估运动的真实性。现有的视频奖励主要依赖二维感知信号，没有显式建模铰接式人体运动背后的三维身体状态、接触和动力学，因此常常给出现身体体漂浮或物理上不合理运动的视频打高分。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PhyMotion，这是一种结构化、细粒度的运动奖励，它将恢复的三维人体轨迹置于物理模拟器中进行验证，并从物理可行性的多个维度评估运动质量。具体而言，我们从生成的视频中恢复SMPL身体网格，将其重定向到MuJoCo物理模拟器中的虚拟人形模型上，并评估……
tldr: PhyMotion提出了一种结构化的三维运动奖励，通过将生成视频中恢复的人体运动导入物理模拟器进行重定向和物理可行性评估，从而生成更加真实、符合物理规律的人体运动视频。
en_tdlr: PhyMotion introduces a structured 3D motion reward that grounds recovered human trajectories in a physics simulator, evaluating physical feasibility across multiple dimensions to enable more realistic and physically plausible human video generation.
